notes: Set before the v2 final sampling; no adjustment to make observed results pass.
DHE and fixed-mode compare against uninstrumented opt8; traditional mode compares against independent opt3.
Steady-state thresholds apply independently to each benchmark. Report MAD and paired differences; no summing opt improvements.
Startup and memory fail only when both relative and absolute limits are exceeded, matching the existing metadata policy's materiality rule.
Startup includes both selection-to-entry and process-to-entry; individual selection latency is reported, not compared to a zero-work baseline.
Passing this Windows policy does not qualify ARM64 or WebGL performance. Binary size is reported separately without claiming a pure-library delta.
